name: ComplyAI
tagline: An assistant that helps companies check compliance with an AI audit checklist and chat.

awards: [Apex Center for Entrepreneurship] Best Startup Hack

problem: Compliance in government and defence work is complex and manual, the team says.
solution: A Next.js app with a persistent profile, an AI chat and a generated audit checklist.
demo_moment: Team-described: create a profile and generate a checklist.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[Apex Center for Entrepreneurship] Best Startup Hack” among 112 submissions.
Draws on the team's own industry experience.

lessons: Domain experience gives a startup pitch credibility.
